top_signals.title: US Plans for Tariffs Face Pushback
top_signals.summary:
Trading partners have responded to the latest US tariff plans with a mix of disappointment and protests, while some hold out the prospect for negotiations. Bloomberg's North Asia correspondent Minmin Low says China and the EU have made it clear that they will retaliate if necessary. 

 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nine hurt in huge explosion at Bangkok oil facility
top_signals.summary: The blast was so strong that it rattled doors several kilometers away, according to reporters.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
